claim: Making `.small-action` a flex container without `flex: 1` on `.small-action-desc` shrink-wraps the description, so its `float: right` edit/delete buttons now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge of the row.

Cutting `.small-action-desc` left padding from 4em to 1.5% leaves mobile's `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` (mobile/topic-post.scss:520), which was sized to cancel that padding, pulling custom small-action messages outside the description box and over the icon.

The `align-items` mixin copies its argument unchanged into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`, which only take `start`/`end` (not `flex-start`/`flex-end`), and emits `-ms-align-items`, which no browser supports, so any future `align-items(flex-start)` call is silently dropped on the prefixed engines.

The `order` mixin passes its value straight to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group`/`-moz-box-ordinal-group`, which need an integer of at least 1 (default 1, while `order` defaults to 0), so `order(0)` or a negative order is invalid in the legacy syntax and ordering against default items drifts by one.
